Fetch a table with UUID references to archival data files

Source: R/get_archival_data_uuid.R
get_archival_data_uuid.Rd

Archival data is stored in csv files hosted on lifewatch.com. To fetch these we must first query ETN for uuids that are needed to build the paths to read these csv files.

Usage

get_archival_data_uuid(
  credentials = list(username = Sys.getenv("ETN_USER"), password = Sys.getenv("ETN_PWD")),
  tag_serial_number = NULL,
  animal_project_code = NULL,
  animal_id = NULL
)

Arguments

credentials

A list with the username and password to connect to the ETN database.

tag_serial_number

Character (vector). One or more tag serial numbers.

animal_project_code

Character (vector). One or more animal project codes. Case-insensitive.

animal_id

Integer (vector). One or more animal identifiers.

Value

A tibble with a column converted_archival_file_uuid that contains the UUID pointing to the archival data csv file. Other columns are: animal_id, tag_serial_number, and animal_project_code.

Examples

get_archival_data_uuid(tag_serial_number = "22035610")
#> Error: ODBC failed with error 00000 from              [unixODBC][Driver Manager].
#> Failed to connect to the database.
#> Did you enter the right username/password?
